Quick note on instrumentation / rollback:

- Primary triggers: p99 latency delta > 30% sustained for 5 minutes OR error-rate increase > 1.5x baseline for 10 minutes.
- Execution owner: infra-runbook on-call (Ben to confirm team) to flip routing back to hosted; automated route switch takes ~2 minutes once triggered.
- Data capture: KV cache hit-rate, request queue length, and GPU/CPU utilization to be logged and surfaced in the Canary dashboard.
